messages:
Ava: FYI auditors just sent a consolidated evidence request for the SOC 2 / ISO 27001 assessment — they want RBAC change history, KMS integration docs, audit log retention mapping, and a vuln triage timeline.
Sam: can you paste the raw asks so we don't miss anything?
Ava: Pasted from the auditor: "1) RBAC change history for org and project roles (last 12 months) incl. who approved; 2) KMS integration architecture and proof that CMKs are rotated/managed via customer KMS for Private customers; 3) Audit log retention configuration and sample exports for last 90 days; 4) Vulnerability triage evidence for high/critical issues in last 6 months; 5) Incident response playbook & evidence of tabletop in last year."
Olivia: OK. I'll own the control mapping against SOC2 CC and ISO 27001 Annex A. I'll need references to logs/artifacts from eng infra and security.
Maria: For RBAC history, we have the admin-audit log in GCP and the internal change requests in Jira (SEC-CHG-). We also track approvers in the RBAC-change form. Quick snippet of query to pull changes from our audit index:
```
GET /logs/_search?q=resource_type:rbac AND timestamp:[now-12M TO now]
{"sort": [{"timestamp": "desc"}], "size": 1000}
```
Kevin: KMS integration docs are in the private repo under infra/kms-integration.md. For Private deployments we wire customer KMS via our KMS-proxy and store only wrapped keys. I'll upload the diagram to the secure share.
Ava: Auditor also wants proof of CMK rotation policy. Kevin, can you confirm rotation schedule and where to grab rotation logs?
Kevin: Rotation is handled by customer KMS for Private (we don't rotate customer CMKs). For Redwood-managed keys we rotate annually and rotation events are logged to CloudAudit logs — example entry id: a1b2-rot-2025. I can export the last 18 months of rotation events.
Sam: For audit logs retention mapping — we have two tables: Hosted (90d by default, extendable to 365d with retention add-on) and Private (customer controlled). Olivia, can you map that to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.12?
Olivia: Yup. I'll create a control matrix. Quick notes: map RBAC change reviews -> SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2; KMS key management -> CC6.3, ISO A.10.1 and A.10.2; log retention -> CC7.2, ISO A.12.4.
Maria: Vulnerability triage evidence: triage board in Jira (VULN-TRIAGE), CVE tracker, and remediation tickets. We can export a CSV of high/critical from last 6 months and include timestamps + PRs.
Ava: Auditor asked for sample evidence upload path and hash. We'll put artifacts on the secure share (s3://redwood-audit-evidence/2025/soc2_iso/) and post hashes here. audit-bot: New evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/2025/soc2_iso/ (access limited, MFA required).
Olivia: Also they want to see one completed incident tabletop deck + minutes. Do we have one from last year?
Sam: We ran a tabletop end-of-year — deck and minutes live in drive/incident-retros. I'll export PDF and redact PII.
Ava: Auditor follow-up: they asked a clarifying Q — for RBAC change approvals, do we have signed approvals or just form-based approvals? They need to verify separation of duties.
Maria: We have form-based approvals + approver SSO signature (SAML assertion logged). Example proof: the RBAC-change form stores approver email + approval timestamp; SAML logs link to that event id.
Olivia: I'll capture both artifacts: the form export, the SAML auth event, and a small write-up explaining the SoD controls.
Kevin: For KMS, auditor also wants to confirm that private deployments do not export unwrapped keys. Confirmed: we never store plaintext keys; only wrapped blobs. Will include code snippet from kms-proxy and a sample wrapped-key header.
Ava: Good. Next steps: Olivia to draft control matrix and list artifact filenames; Maria/Kevin to export artifacts and upload to s3; Sam to coordinate responses and get sign-off from Security Ops.
Sam: I'll open a coordination ticket SEC-AUD-2025-12 and assign owners. ETA for first bundle: 5 business days.
Olivia: I'll start the control mapping now and post the matrix here when ready. :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks team. If auditors send any more ad-hoc Qs, ping me.
audit-bot: Reminder — retention policy doc v2 submitted for review (link: https://docs.redwoodops/reten-v2).
